name: McGill University
description: McGill University is a public research university in Montreal, Quebec, founded in 1821. It teaches in English and is known for medicine, law, science and engineering, with international students making up nearly 30% of its enrolment.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website); its MD, CM is on the Singapore Medical Council's list, and the campus has a Malaysian and Singaporean Students' Association.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Civil Law and Juris Doctor (BCL/JD)
programmes.notes: 2026-27 international fees, 30 credits, by admission year; tuition guaranteed for the programme. McGill classes the BCL/JD as an undergraduate programme (listed with its international undergraduate rates) although most entrants hold a prior degree, so it is filed as graduate-entry here. Compulsory = society, student services, admin, copyright, IT and SSMU dental fees; international health insurance (C$1,212) excluded. Programme is 105 credits, typically 3-3.5 years.

programmes.name: Doctor of Medicine and Master of Surgery (MDCM)
programmes.notes: Student Accounts '2026-2027 Tuition Rates - International Undergraduate Students' (updated December 2025): MDCM tuition C$74,678.31 for students admitted Fall 2026, based on 63 credits in Year 1 (the heaviest year; McGill lists 50.5, 51 and 35.5 credits for Years 2-4, so later years cost less). Per-credit rate guaranteed for the programme. Compulsory = society C$779.50 + student services/athletics C$774.60 + admin C$651.89 + copyright C$55.05 + IT C$440.55 + SSMU dental C$150 (estimated by McGill at +3%); international health insurance (C$1,155) excluded. Graduate-entry MDCM is 4 years. No 2024/2025 history: the 2025-26 MDCM page shows cohort figures that are inconsistent with this schedule, so none recorded.
